verdict.rationale: Filee documents image conversion that covers iPhone HEIC and other photo/graphics formats, and SVG output via a built-in Trace to SVG (plus DWG→PNG/SVG). Its per-file-type presets give power-user control over quality and resizing, along with DPI, grayscale and metadata. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of JPEG and WebP input/output, a documented image-specific compression setting (the only compression evidence covers PDFs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
